description: MAP-13 `defaulted` (decision 2026-09-14 §4.8): the Messages API requires max_tokens; when Config.max_tokens is absent the class ceiling is sent (16384 for the 4.x class and any unknown name; 8192 for claude-3-5; 4096 for claude-3-haiku/opus/sonnet) and RECORDED. Until 2026-09-14 the default was a silent 1024, which cut ordinary answers off with nothing said — a user switching from OpenAI saw truncated text. A value above a model's real ceiling is a loud 400 naming it, never a silent truncation. Consumer-side; no live wire.

provenance.evidence: changes/2026-09-14-adapt-visibly.md §3a (MAP-13, ratified 2026-09-14); ceilings from Anthropic's models table (4.x: ≥32k output; 3.5: 8192; 3: 4096)

canonical_request_provenance.evidence: the smallest request with no max_tokens
